summary: benaadams 提交 EIP-8141（frame 交易）的规范收紧，把 frame 模式、批准语义、默认代码行为与公共内存池规则写得更明确。EIP-8037 两项状态 gas 记账澄清提交。Magicians 上出现 ERC-8227，提出余额经 FHE 加密、转账用 ZK 验证的同质化代币。growthepie 提示主网再次出现大规模地址投毒攻击。

items.topic: 原生 AA：EIP-8141 规范收紧
items.title: EIP-8141：收紧规范
items.note: （benaadams）提交：把打包的 frame `mode` 字段拆成 `mode` 与 `flags`，新增 `FRAMEPARAM` 并引入明确的 `resolved_target`，使 frame 模型、批准语义、默认代码行为和公共内存池规则更明确、内部一致。
items.note_en: (benaadams), submitted: splits the packed frame `mode` field into `mode` and `flags`, adds `FRAMEPARAM` and an explicit `resolved_target`, making the frame model, approval semantics, default code behavior and public mempool rules more explicit and internally consistent.

items.topic: 交易与 gas：EIP-8037 状态 gas 记账
items.title: EIP-8037：澄清溢出的状态 gas 仍计入 execution_state_gas_used
items.note: （qu0b）提交：状态 gas 超出 `state_gas_reservoir` 而从 `gas_left` 扣除时，仍全额计入状态 gas，计数按成本类型而非资金来源归类。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: clarify that spillover state gas still increments execution_state_gas_used
items.note_en: (qu0b), submitted: when a state gas charge exceeds `state_gas_reservoir` and spills into `gas_left`, it still counts fully as state gas; counters are classified by cost type, not funding source.

summary_en: benaadams submitted a tightening of the EIP-8141 (frame transaction) spec, making frame modes, approval semantics, default code behavior and public mempool rules more explicit. Two EIP-8037 state gas accounting clarifications were submitted. ERC-8227 appeared on Magicians, proposing a fungible token with FHE encrypted balances and ZK verified transfers. growthepie flagged another mass address poisoning attack on mainnet.
